verdict.rationale: Granola exposes a documented RESTful API and an official hosted MCP server (confirmed live via runtime probe with OAuth), which lets AI-native users build custom agents/integrations, but there is no evidence of official language SDKs, client libraries, or a discoverable OpenAPI/swagger spec (probe found only 404s). Missing for 10: published SDKs in common languages, an OpenAPI spec, and independent developer corroboration of building against the API.
